LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 8.1.2 PASSING INFORMATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Observing and Articulating signs 8.1.2 Passing information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 8.1.2 Passing information, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you do before coming to school? 2. What do you do when you arrive at schools?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 8.1.2 Passing information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration as learner talks about things done at different times of the day collaboratively.

● Critical thinking and problem solving as learner recalls chores that happen in their homes every morning.

Values:
122

● Respect: patience as learners take turn while talking about various activities done on a daily routine.

● Peace: responsibility as learner tells about chores that take place at home while others listen attentively.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner, with others work collaboratively in talking about things done at different times of the day.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Learner relates singing songs related to time and daily routine with singing in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book, Signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures, online resources, relevant digital
